question: Which of the following states has the lowest literacy rate in India according to census 2011?
solution:
**The correct answer is 'Bihar'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lowest Literacy Rate - Bihar:**

 
 
• According to the Census 2011, Bihar recorded the lowest literacy rate among all Indian states at 61.80%.
 
• This low literacy rate is a result of several factors, including inadequate educational infrastructure, high dropout rates, poverty, and socio-economic challenges.
 
• Government efforts and various educational programs aim to address these issues, but significant challenges remain in improving literacy in the state.
 
• Male literacy in Bihar stands at 71.20%, while female literacy is considerably lower at 51.50%, highlighting gender disparity in education.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh:**

 
 
• In the 2011 Census, Andhra Pradesh had a literacy rate of around 67.02%.
 
• While lower than the national average, it was still higher than Bihar's literacy rate.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve literacy through initiatives in education and skill development, especially in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Odisha:**
 
 
• Odisha had a literacy rate of 72.87% as per the 2011 Census.
 
• Though better than both Bihar and Andhra Pradesh, it still faces challenges in achieving higher literacy rates, particularly among tribal populations.
 
• Programs focusing on adult literacy and school enrolment have been implemented to address these issues.
 
 
 
• **Haryana:**
 
 
• Haryana had a literacy rate of 76.64% according to the Census 2011.
 
• This state shows better performance in literacy compared to Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, and Odisha.
 
• Haryana has made significant strides in improving education through various state-led initiatives, focusing on both male and female education.
